client_request_id.description: A new unique identifier for this request, for example a UUID. If the response is lost, send the same call again with the same value. Do not reuse the value for a different request.

message.description: The answer to the question of the operation, an approval decision, or a correction from the user.

operation_id.description: The operation id that posthog-agent-run returned.

project_id.description: The project id of the operation, from the `project.id` field of the operation.
